Question 3

A particle P moves along the x-axis. When the displacement of P from the origin O is x meters, its velocity is vm/s and its acceleration is 3x2+23m/s2. Which differential equation describes this motion?

a
 dvdx=3x2+23
b
 ddx(12v2)=3x2+23
c
 2dvdx=3x2+23
d
 ddx(2v2)=3x2+23
e
 ddx(14v2)=3x2+23
